name: afkoi
description: 🎣 Your AI agents' working hours, turned into fishing. A playful usage tracker & global leaderboard for Claude Code / Codex / Gemini — desktop pet + zero-backend pond on GitHub Pages.

paragraphs: Your AI agents' working hours, turned into fishing.

AFKoi is a playful usage tracker and global leaderboard for AI coding agents. Every turn, tool call, and active hour your agents (Claude Code / Codex / Gemini) rack up becomes fishing energy — a little desktop robot fishes with it, your catches build a dex, and your real agent activity decides your rank on the global leaderboard.
features: A stat you can watch: instead of a dashboard, your agent activity is a pond on your desktop — the busier your agents, the harder the little robot fishes. Rare catches literally mean "my agents worked a lot this week."

A leaderboard that means something: the global pond ranks people by real, measured agent activity (log-compressed so grinders don't drown everyone) — rendered live from everyone's data on GitHub Pages, no backend.
Zero intrusion: activity is observed passively from agent logs and processes. No window injection, no MCP, no slowdown — close the pet anytime, your agents never notice.
Privacy: only counts and stats ever leave your machine — never prompts, code, or paths.

whatItDoes.text: Your AI agents' working hours, turned into fishing.

requirements.text: GitHub CLI (recommended, fully automatic): brew install gh && gh auth login — the pet creates and updates your Gist and registers you automatically.
